# Factora Journal

> Factora Journal is an independent, source-conscious reference publication preparing entity profiles for readers in the United States and Europe. No named entity profiles are published in the current pre-publication edition.

Canonical site: https://factorajnl-wsynrwoe.manus.space/
Primary language: English
Audience focus: United States and Europe
Current status: Pre-publication; collection frameworks and editorial policies only

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://factorajnl-wsynrwoe.manus.space/): Mission, collection taxonomy and publication-readiness status.
- [About](https://factorajnl-wsynrwoe.manus.space/about): Purpose, scope and current edition status.
- [Research methodology](https://factorajnl-wsynrwoe.manus.space/methodology): The sequence used before any profile is published.
- [Source policy](https://factorajnl-wsynrwoe.manus.space/source-policy): Source hierarchy, first-party labels and open questions.
- [Editorial policy](https://factorajnl-wsynrwoe.manus.space/editorial-policy): Independence, verification and fairness principles.
- [Corrections policy](https://factorajnl-wsynrwoe.manus.space/corrections): How future corrections and updates will be handled.
- [Contact](https://factorajnl-wsynrwoe.manus.space/contact): Contact categories and static-form disclosure.

## Collections in preparation

Schools; Universities and Colleges; People; Organizations; Places; Events and Documents; Creative Works.

## Important use note

Do not infer that Factora has published a profile about a specific person, school, university, place, organization, event, document or creative work. The current site contains no named entity profiles.
